## Setup

Install the required packages once with `install.packages(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "ggplot2", "readr", "Matrix"))`. Set the recording ID and directories below. The pixel-to-millimeter conversion should match the recording calibration.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

if (!requireNamespace("Matrix", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install Matrix with install.packages('Matrix').")
}

video_id <- "14_19_23"
input_dir <- "."
output_dir <- input_dir
pixpermm <- 2.6
swap_starts <- numeric(0)
```

## Load tracking results and anatomical priors

Run `Prior.qmd` first. The revised notebook saves four recording-specific RDS files. 

```{r}
#| label: load-data
read_input <- function(prefix, legacy = NULL) {
  path <- file.path(input_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", video_id, ".rds"))
  if (!file.exists(path) && !is.null(legacy)) {
    path <- file.path(input_dir, legacy)
    warning("Using legacy file: ", path, "; verify its recording ID.")
  }
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)
  readRDS(path)
}

coords_data <- read_input("Tracked")
raw_preds <- read_input("SLEAP_pred", "SLEAP_pred.rds")
pri_list <- read_input("priors", "priors_list.rds")
manual <- read_input("manual")

# Accept both the revised Prior.qmd output and the original prior list.
priors <- if (all(c("NM", "TM", "TN") %in% names(pri_list))) {
  pri_list[c("NM", "TM", "TN")]
} else {
  list(
    NM = c(mean = pri_list$pri_dnm_mean, sd = pri_list$pri_dnm_sd),
    TM = c(mean = pri_list$pri_dtm_mean, sd = pri_list$pri_dtm_sd),
    TN = c(mean = pri_list$pri_dtn_mean, sd = pri_list$pri_dtn_sd)
  )
}
priors$ANGLE <- c(mean = pri_list$circ_mean, sd = pri_list$circ_sd)
```

## Kalman filtering and skeleton smoothing

The six-dimensional state contains the nose, mid-center and tail-base coordinates for each mouse. The forward filter combines reliable observations with anatomical pseudo-observations; the backward RTS pass refines the trajectory. The original numerical update, angular convention and blending rule are retained. In particular, missing original coordinates can remain missing after blending.

```{r}
#| label: smoother
kalman_skeleton_smoother <- function(coords_data,
priors, max_skel_sd_mult = 3.5, motion_alpha = 40,
smooth_weight = 0.85, # Weight on smoothed predictions in final predictions (mixed with original predictions)
q = 8,                 # process noise variance (per-dim)
obs_sd = 3,             # observation noise sd for reliable coordinates
angle_weight = 0.9,
prior_strength = 9,
verbose = FALSE) {
  # helpers
  dist_xy <- function(a,b) {
    if (any(is.na(a)) || any(is.na(b))) return(NA_real_)
    sqrt( (a[1]-b[1])^2 + (a[2]-b[2])^2 )
  }

  state_idx <- function(part, axis) {
    # ordering: nose(1,2), mid(3,4), tail(5,6)
    base <- switch(part,
    nose = 0,
    mid  = 2,
    tail = 4,
    stop("bad part"))
    if (axis == "x") return(base + 1)
    if (axis == "y") return(base + 2)
    stop("bad axis")
  }

  # skeleton functions: distances (NM, TM, TN) and angle at mid (nose-mid vs tail-mid)
  g_distances <- function(xstate) {
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]
    mid  <- xstate[c(3,4)]
    tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    c(dist_xy(nose, mid), dist_xy(tail, mid), dist_xy(tail, nose))
  }

  # angle between A = nose - mid and B = tail - mid
  g_angle <- function(xstate) {
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]; mid <- xstate[c(3,4)]; tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    A <- nose - mid; B <- tail - mid
    dot <- A[1]*B[1] + A[2]*B[2]
    det <- A[1]*B[2] - A[2]*B[1]
    atan2(det, dot)  # value in [-pi, pi]
  }

  # Jacobian of distances (3x6) -
  jacobian_g <- function(xstate) {
    J <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 6)
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]; mid <- xstate[c(3,4)]; tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    set_row <- function(row, a_idx, b_idx, a_pt, b_pt) {
      dvec <- a_pt - b_pt
      d <- sqrt(sum(dvec^2))
      if (d <= 1e-8) return(NULL)
      da <- dvec / d
      db <- -dvec / d
      J[row, a_idx:(a_idx+1)] <<- da
      J[row, b_idx:(b_idx+1)] <<- db
      NULL
    }
    set_row(1, 1, 3, nose, mid)   # NM: nose - mid
    set_row(2, 5, 3, tail, mid)   # TM: tail - mid
    set_row(3, 5, 1, tail, nose)  # TN: tail - nose
    J
  }

  # Jacobian of the angle θ = atan2(det, dot) wrt state (1 x 6)
  jacobian_angle <- function(xstate) {
    # order: [n_x, n_y, m_x, m_y, t_x, t_y]
    nose <- xstate[c(1,2)]; mid <- xstate[c(3,4)]; tail <- xstate[c(5,6)]
    A <- nose - mid
    B <- tail - mid
    dot <- A[1]*B[1] + A[2]*B[2]
    det <- A[1]*B[2] - A[2]*B[1]
    denom <- det^2 + dot^2
    if (denom <= 1e-12) {
      # near-collinear / degenerate -> return zeros to avoid numeric blowups
      return(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = 6))
    }

    pd_det <- numeric(6)
    pd_det[1] <-  B[2]            # n_x
    pd_det[2] <- -B[1]            # n_y
    pd_det[5] <- -A[2]            # t_x
    pd_det[6] <-  A[1]            # t_y
    pd_det[3] <- -B[2] + A[2]     # m_x
    pd_det[4] <- -A[1] + B[1]     # m_y

    pd_dot <- numeric(6)
    pd_dot[1] <- B[1]
    pd_dot[2] <- B[2]
    pd_dot[5] <- A[1]
    pd_dot[6] <- A[2]
    pd_dot[3] <- -B[1] - A[1]
    pd_dot[4] <- -B[2] - A[2]

    grad <- (dot * pd_det - det * pd_dot) / denom
    matrix(as.numeric(grad), nrow = 1)  # 1 x 6
  }

  make_H_obs <- function(obs_mask) {
    # obs_mask: logical length 3 (nose,mid,tail) indicating which parts are observed and reliable
    rows <- which(obs_mask)
    if (length(rows) == 0) return(list(H = matrix(0, 0, 6), z = numeric(0)))
    H <- matrix(0, nrow = 2 * length(rows), ncol = 6)
    z_len <- nrow(H)
    z <- numeric(z_len)
    r <- 1
    for (ri in rows) {
      part <- c("nose","mid","tail")[ri]
      ix <- state_idx(part, "x")
      iy <- state_idx(part, "y")
      H[r, ix] <- 1
      H[r+1, iy] <- 1
      r <- r + 2
    }
    list(H = H, z = z)
  }

  msafe_inv <- function(M) {
    tryCatch(solve(M), error = function(e) solve(M + diag(1e-8, nrow(M))))
  }

  # checks & prep
  # Require NM, TM, TN and ANGLE in priors
  if (!all(c("NM","TM","TN","ANGLE") %in% names(priors))) stop("priors must contain NM, TM, TN, and ANGLE (mean, sd)")
  skel_sd_vec <- as.numeric(c(priors$NM["sd"], priors$TM["sd"], priors$TN["sd"]))
  skel_mean_vec <- as.numeric(c(priors$NM["mean"], priors$TM["mean"], priors$TN["mean"]))
  angle_sd <- as.numeric(priors$ANGLE["sd"])
  angle_mean <- as.numeric(priors$ANGLE["mean"])
  if (any(is.na(skel_sd_vec) | skel_sd_vec <= 0)) stop("skeleton prior sds must be positive numbers")
  if (is.na(angle_sd) || angle_sd <= 0) stop("ANGLE prior sd must be positive")

  # required columns names (expects lowercase part keys )
  required_cols0 <- c("inst0_nose_x","inst0_nose_y","inst0_mid_x","inst0_mid_y","inst0_tail_x","inst0_tail_y",
  "reliability_nose0","reliability_mid0","reliability_tail0")
  required_cols1 <- c("inst1_nose_x","inst1_nose_y","inst1_mid_x","inst1_mid_y","inst1_tail_x","inst1_tail_y",
  "reliability_nose1","reliability_mid1","reliability_tail1")
  if (!all(required_cols0 %in% colnames(coords_data))) stop("coords_data missing required inst0 columns")
  if (!all(required_cols1 %in% colnames(coords_data))) stop("coords_data missing required inst1 columns")

  coords_pred <- coords_data  # copy
  n_rows <- nrow(coords_data)
  if (n_rows == 0) stop("No tracking frames supplied")
  parts <- c("nose","mid","tail")

  # add pred & sd cols
  for (inst in 0:1) {
    for (p in parts) {
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_pred") ]] <- NA_real_
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_pred") ]] <- NA_real_
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_sd") ]]   <- NA_real_
      coords_pred[[ paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_sd") ]]   <- NA_real_
    }
  }

  # Kalman matrices
  A <- diag(6)
  Q <- diag(q, 6)
  I6 <- diag(6)

  # main per-instance loop
  for (inst in 0:1) {
    if (verbose) message("Processing instance ", inst)

    obs_cols <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", rep(parts, each = 2), "_", rep(c("x", "y"), 3))
    obs_mat <- as.matrix(coords_data[, obs_cols])
    storage.mode(obs_mat) <- "double"
    rel_mat <- as.matrix(coords_data[, paste0("reliability_", parts, inst)])
    rel_mat <- matrix(as.logical(rel_mat), nrow = n_rows, ncol = 3)
    rel_mat[is.na(rel_mat)] <- FALSE

    # Limit nose-mid and tail-mid distances before filtering.
    adjust_dist <- function(a, b, target_d) {
      v <- a - b
      d <- sqrt(sum(v^2))
      if (is.na(d) || d < 1e-8) return(a)
      b + v * (target_d / d)
    }

    d_mean <- skel_mean_vec
    d_sd   <- skel_sd_vec
    d_min  <- d_mean - max_skel_sd_mult * d_sd
    d_max  <- d_mean + max_skel_sd_mult * d_sd

    for (t in seq_len(n_rows)) {

      # extract coordinates
      nose_idx <- c(state_idx("nose", "x"), state_idx("nose", "y"))
      mid_idx  <- c(state_idx("mid",  "x"), state_idx("mid",  "y"))
      tail_idx <- c(state_idx("tail", "x"), state_idx("tail", "y"))

      nose <- obs_mat[t, nose_idx]
      mid  <- obs_mat[t, mid_idx]
      tail <- obs_mat[t, tail_idx]

      # Nose–Mid
      NM <- sqrt(sum((nose - mid)^2))
      if (!is.na(NM) && (NM < d_min[1] || NM > d_max[1])) {
        nose <- adjust_dist(nose, mid, min(max(NM, d_min[1]), d_max[1]))
      }

      # Tail–Mid
      TM <- sqrt(sum((tail - mid)^2))
      if (!is.na(TM) && (TM < d_min[2] || TM > d_max[2])) {
        tail <- adjust_dist(tail, mid, min(max(TM, d_min[2]), d_max[2]))
      }

      # update obs_mat with adjusted coordinates
      obs_mat[t, nose_idx] <- nose
      obs_mat[t, tail_idx] <- tail
    }

    Tlen <- n_rows

    # storage
    x_pred_fwd <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = Tlen)
    P_pred_fwd <- array(0, dim = c(6,6,Tlen))
    x_filt <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = Tlen)
    P_filt <- array(0, dim = c(6,6,Tlen))

    # init
    x_prev <- rep(0, 6)
    P_prev <- diag(1e4, 6)
    first_obs_idx <- which(!is.na(obs_mat[1, ]))
    if (length(first_obs_idx) > 0) {
      x_prev[first_obs_idx] <- obs_mat[1, first_obs_idx]
      for (ii in first_obs_idx) P_prev[ii, ii] <- obs_sd^2
    }

    # forward filter
    for (t in seq_len(Tlen)) {
      # predict
      xpred <- as.numeric(A %*% x_prev)
      Ppred <- A %*% P_prev %*% t(A) + Q

      # build observed-coordinate measurement (only reliable parts)
      obs_flags <- rel_mat[t, ]
      obs_info <- make_H_obs(obs_flags)
      H_obs <- obs_info$H
      z_obs <- numeric(nrow(H_obs))
      if (nrow(H_obs) > 0) {
        r_idx <- 1
        for (pi in which(obs_flags)) {
          px <- obs_mat[t, state_idx(c("nose","mid","tail")[pi], "x")]
          py <- obs_mat[t, state_idx(c("nose","mid","tail")[pi], "y")]
          z_obs[r_idx] <- px; z_obs[r_idx+1] <- py
          r_idx <- r_idx + 2
        }
        R_obs <- diag(obs_sd^2, nrow(H_obs))
      } else {
        R_obs <- matrix(0, 0, 0)
      }

      # skeleton pseudo-observation: distances + angle
      g_pred <- g_distances(xpred)
      z_skel <- skel_mean_vec
      H_skel_dist <- jacobian_g(xpred)     # 3 x 6

      # angle
      ang_pred <- g_angle(xpred)
      z_ang <- angle_mean
      H_ang <- jacobian_angle(xpred)       # 1 x 6

      # compute raw innovation and wrap to [-pi, pi]
      innov_raw_ang <- z_ang - ang_pred
      innov_wrapped_ang <- ((innov_raw_ang + pi) %% (2 * pi)) - pi

      # Use the wrapped angular innovation without capping
      z_ang_wrapped <- ang_pred + innov_wrapped_ang

      # combine distance and angle parts
      H_skel <- rbind(H_skel_dist, H_ang)  # 4 x 6
      z_skel_comb <- c(z_skel, z_ang_wrapped)

      # apply tunable weight between distance and angle priors
      R_skel <- as.matrix(Matrix::bdiag(
      diag(as.numeric(skel_sd_vec^2), 3) * prior_strength * (1 - angle_weight),   # smaller angle_weight → stronger distance prior
      matrix(angle_sd^2 * (prior_strength * angle_weight), 1, 1)              # larger angle_weight → stronger angle prior
      ))



      # combine with observed coordinates if any
      if (nrow(H_obs) > 0) {
        H_comb <- rbind(H_obs, H_skel)
        z_comb <- c(z_obs, z_skel_comb)
        # use Matrix::bdiag safely
        R_comb <- as.matrix(Matrix::bdiag(R_obs, R_skel))
      } else {
        H_comb <- H_skel
        z_comb <- z_skel_comb
        R_comb <- as.matrix(R_skel)
      }

      # EKF-like linear update
      S <- H_comb %*% Ppred %*% t(H_comb) + R_comb
      S_inv <- msafe_inv(S)
      K <- Ppred %*% t(H_comb) %*% S_inv
      innov <- z_comb - as.numeric(H_comb %*% xpred)
      xupd <- as.numeric(xpred + K %*% innov)
      Pupd <- (I6 - K %*% H_comb) %*% Ppred
      Pupd <- (Pupd + t(Pupd)) / 2

      # store
      x_pred_fwd[, t] <- xpred
      P_pred_fwd[,, t] <- Ppred
      x_filt[, t] <- xupd
      P_filt[,, t] <- Pupd

      # next
      x_prev <- xupd
      P_prev <- Pupd
    } # forward

    # Backward RTS smoother
    x_smooth <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = Tlen)
    P_smooth <- array(0, dim = c(6,6,Tlen))
    x_smooth[, Tlen] <- x_filt[, Tlen]
    P_smooth[,, Tlen] <- P_filt[,, Tlen]
    if (Tlen >= 2) {
      for (t in seq(Tlen-1, 1)) {
        Pf <- P_filt[,, t]
        Pp1 <- P_pred_fwd[,, t+1]
        C <- Pf %*% t(A) %*% msafe_inv(Pp1)
        x_smooth[, t] <- x_filt[, t] + C %*% (x_smooth[, t+1] - x_pred_fwd[, t+1])
        P_smooth[,, t] <- P_filt[,, t] + C %*% (P_smooth[,, t+1] - Pp1) %*% t(C)
        P_smooth[,, t] <- (P_smooth[,, t] + t(P_smooth[,, t])) / 2
      }
    }

    for (t in seq_len(Tlen)) {
      xs <- x_smooth[, t]
      Ps <- P_smooth[,, t]
      sds <- sqrt(pmax(0, diag(Ps)))
      for (p in parts) {
        ix <- state_idx(p, "x"); iy <- state_idx(p, "y")
        col_x_pred <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_pred")
        col_y_pred <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_pred")
        col_x_sd   <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_x_sd")
        col_y_sd   <- paste0("inst", inst, "_", p, "_y_sd")

        part_idx <- match(p, parts)

        # reliability function
        is_rel <- function(ii) {
          # check current frame reliability
          if (!isTRUE(rel_mat[ii, part_idx]) ||
          any(is.na(obs_mat[ii, c(ix, iy)]))) {
            return(FALSE)
          }

          # get neighbor frames within bounds
          neighbors <- setdiff(pmax(1, ii - 1):pmin(Tlen, ii + 1), ii)

          # current frame coordinates
          cur_xy <- obs_mat[ii, c(ix, iy)]

          # check that all existing neighbors (if any) have valid coords and
          # are within motion_alpha distance (and not identical)
          for (f in neighbors) {
            neigh_xy <- obs_mat[f, c(ix, iy)]
            if (any(is.na(neigh_xy))) return(FALSE)
            dist <- sqrt(sum((cur_xy - neigh_xy)^2))
            if (dist == 0 || dist > motion_alpha) return(FALSE)
          }

          TRUE
        }

        # Apply rule:
        if (is_rel(t)) {
          coords_pred[[col_x_pred]][t] <- obs_mat[t, ix]
          coords_pred[[col_y_pred]][t] <- obs_mat[t, iy]
        } else {
          coords_pred[[col_x_pred]][t] <- smooth_weight * xs[ix] + (1 - smooth_weight) * obs_mat[t, ix]
          coords_pred[[col_y_pred]][t] <- smooth_weight * xs[iy] + (1 - smooth_weight) * obs_mat[t, iy]
        }

        # keep sd from smoothed posterior (unchanged)
        coords_pred[[ col_x_sd ]][t] <- sds[ix]
        coords_pred[[ col_y_sd ]][t] <- sds[iy]
      }
    }

    if (verbose) message("Instance ", inst, " smoothing done.")
  } # instances loop

  if (verbose) message("Kalman + skeleton smoothing complete with angle prior.")
  coords_pred
}
```

## Run the smoother

These parameters match the original notebook example.

```{r}
#| label: run-smoother
coords_pred <- kalman_skeleton_smoother(
  coords_data, priors,
  smooth_weight = 0.85, q = 8, max_skel_sd_mult = 3.5,
  motion_alpha = 40, obs_sd = 3, angle_weight = 0.9,
  prior_strength = 9, verbose = TRUE
)
```

## Evaluate against manual annotations

Compare raw, tracked and smoothed predictions using identity matching. Raw MSFE is restricted to complete frames; tracked and smoothed MSFE use all manually labelled frames. Coverage represents the percentage of body parts that have a valid coordinate set prediction. 

```{r}
#| label: evaluate
normalize_node <- function(node) {
  node <- stringr::str_to_lower(node)

  dplyr::case_when(
    node %in% c("mid-center", "mid_center", "center") ~ "mid",
    node %in% c("tail-base", "tail_base", "base") ~ "tail",
    TRUE ~ node
  )
}

manual_clean <- manual %>%
  transmute(frame = as.integer(frame), instance = as.integer(instance),
    node = normalize_node(node), x_true = x, y_true = y)

prepare_predictions <- function(data, source) {
  if (source == "Raw") {
    out <- data %>%
      select(frame, instance, matches("^(x|y)_(Nose|Mid-center|Tail-base)$")) %>%
      pivot_longer(-c(frame, instance), names_to = c(".value", "node"),
        names_pattern = "(x|y)_(.*)")
  } else {
    pattern <- if (source == "Smoothed") {
      "^inst(\\d+)_(nose|mid|tail)_(x_pred|y_pred|x_sd|y_sd)$"
    } else "^inst(\\d+)_(nose|mid|tail)_(x|y)$"
    out <- data %>%
      select(frame, matches(pattern)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-frame, names_to = c("instance", "node", ".value"),
        names_pattern = pattern)
    if (source == "Smoothed") out <- rename(out, x = x_pred, y = y_pred)
  }
  out %>% mutate(frame = as.integer(frame), instance = as.integer(instance),
    node = normalize_node(node)) %>% rename(x_m_pred = x, y_m_pred = y)
}

# Compare both identity assignments using matching landmark names.
evaluate_predictions <- function(pred, manual_clean, complete_frames = FALSE) {
  keys <- c("frame", "instance", "node")
  if (anyDuplicated(pred[keys]) || anyDuplicated(manual_clean[keys])) {
    stop("Duplicate frame/instance/node keys in evaluation data")
  }
  joined <- manual_clean %>% left_join(pred, by = keys) %>%
    left_join(manual_clean %>% transmute(frame, instance = 1L - instance,
      node, x_swap = x_true, y_swap = y_true), by = keys) %>%
    mutate(error_direct = (x_m_pred - x_true)^2 + (y_m_pred - y_true)^2,
      error_swap = (x_m_pred - x_swap)^2 + (y_m_pred - y_swap)^2)
  # Use the same available landmarks for both candidate assignments.
  flags <- joined %>% group_by(frame) %>% summarise(
    best_swap = isTRUE(mean(error_swap[is.finite(error_direct) & is.finite(error_swap)]) <
      mean(error_direct[is.finite(error_direct) & is.finite(error_swap)])), .groups = "drop")
  evaluated <- joined %>% left_join(flags, by = "frame") %>%
    mutate(x_true = if_else(best_swap, x_swap, x_true),
      y_true = if_else(best_swap, y_swap, y_true),
      error = (x_m_pred - x_true)^2 + (y_m_pred - y_true)^2) %>%
    rename(body_part = node)
  by_frame <- evaluated %>% group_by(frame) %>% summarise(
    n_non_na = sum(is.finite(error)), n_total = n(),
    msfe = if (n_non_na == 0 || (complete_frames && n_non_na != n_total)) NA_real_
      else mean(error[is.finite(error)]), .groups = "drop")
  list(data = evaluated, by_frame = by_frame)
}

sources <- list(Raw = raw_preds, Tracked = coords_pred, Smoothed = coords_pred)
evaluations <- lapply(names(sources), function(source) {
  evaluate_predictions(prepare_predictions(sources[[source]], source),
    manual_clean, complete_frames = source == "Raw")
})
names(evaluations) <- names(sources)

df_eval_eff <- evaluations$Smoothed$data
msfe_by_frame_combined <- bind_rows(lapply(names(evaluations), function(source) {
  mutate(evaluations[[source]]$by_frame, source = source)
}))
msfe_wide <- msfe_by_frame_combined %>% select(frame, source, msfe) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = msfe) %>% rename(Frame = frame)

# Report coverage and frame-averaged errors on the same scale for all sources.
msfe_summary <- msfe_by_frame_combined %>% group_by(source) %>% summarise(
  coverage = sum(n_non_na) / sum(n_total),
  frames_evaluated = sum(is.finite(msfe)),
  msfe_mm2 = mean(msfe, na.rm = TRUE) / pixpermm^2,
  rmse_mm = sqrt(msfe_mm2), .groups = "drop")
print(msfe_summary)
```

## Error and calibration diagnostics

Inspect frame-level error and radial PIT values. The PIT calculation assumes independent Gaussian coordinate errors and uses the smoothed marginal standard deviations.

```{r}
#| label: diagnostics
ggplot(msfe_by_frame_combined, aes(frame, msfe, color = source)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "MSFE by frame", x = "Frame", y = "MSFE (pixels squared)", color = "Source") +
  theme_minimal()

df_pit <- df_eval_eff %>%
  filter(is.finite(error), is.finite(x_sd), is.finite(y_sd), x_sd > 0, y_sd > 0) %>%
  mutate(z_dist = sqrt((x_true - x_m_pred)^2 / x_sd^2 +
    (y_true - y_m_pred)^2 / y_sd^2), pit = 1 - exp(-z_dist^2 / 2))

ggplot(df_pit, aes(pit)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, boundary = 0, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = nrow(df_pit) / 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "PITs (2D Gaussian posterior predictive)", x = "PIT value", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

print(head(select(df_eval_eff, frame, instance, body_part, x_m_pred, y_m_pred, x_true, y_true), 10))
```

## Export corrected coordinates

The CSV contains frame, track, node, x and y. Optional identity corrections are specified by `swap_starts` in Setup. Relabeling preserves coordinates and avoids swapping each pair twice.

```{r}
#| label: export
sleap_long <- prepare_predictions(coords_pred, "Smoothed") %>%
  transmute(frame, track = instance,
    node = dplyr::recode(node, nose = "Nose", mid = "Mid-center", tail = "Tail-base"),
    x = x_m_pred, y = y_m_pred)

# Each listed frame toggles the identity labels for subsequent frames.
swap_tracks <- function(df, swap_starts) {
  swap_flag <- findInterval(df$frame, sort(swap_starts)) %% 2 == 1
  idx <- swap_flag & df$track %in% c(0L, 1L)
  df$track[idx] <- 1L - df$track[idx]
  arrange(df, frame, track, node)
}

df_swapped <- swap_tracks(sleap_long, swap_starts)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(df_swapped, file.path(output_dir, paste0("kalman_predictions_", video_id, ".csv")))
```
